ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 output application/java --- if(not isEmpty(vars.vehicleCode))(vars.vehicleCode replace "'" with "\'") else null

%dw 2.0 output application/java --- if((not isEmpty(vars.vehicleCode)) and (not isEmpty(vars.vehicleType)))((vars.vehicleCode contains ("GENERIC")) or (vars.vehicleCode contains ("DEFAULT")) or ((vars.vehicleType != "RT") and (vars.vehicleType != "RP") and (vars.vehicleType != "RS") and (vars.vehicleType != "RH") and (vars.vehicleType != "RM"))) else true

ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 output application/java --- if(not isEmpty(vars.factoryWarrantyDetails)) vars.factoryWarrantyDetails.bscTermMonth else ""
%dw 2.0 output application/java --- if(not isEmpty(vars.factoryWarrantyDetails)) vars.factoryWarrantyDetails.ptTermMonth else ""
